author: Lintuxer
description: Invoice Ninja 5 — invoicing, quotes, recurring billing, time tracking and online payments. MySQL and Redis are part of the same ZimaOS app; PDFs are rendered by the Chrome that ships inside the app image.

tips.before_install: Set APP_URL to the address you browse to (including the port), generate your own APP_KEY, and change IN_PASSWORD before the first start. The admin account is created once, on first start.

title: Invoice Ninja
